name: retrospect
source:
The story begins when a girl named Nayu comes to visit Subaru, an Onmyoji.

Nayu asks Subaru to mourn four ghosts who are her friends and family. The player will enter Subaru's point of view and trace the memories of the ghosts in the process of mourning.

[Taken from Steam]
translation:
故事开始于一位名叫奈由的女孩拜访阴阳师昴的时候。

娜优要求昴哀悼她的朋友和家人四个鬼魂。玩家将进入昴的视角，在哀悼的过程中追寻鬼魂的记忆。

[取自Steam]
